summary: Layered on top of through-task-015 (Tasks 1-13, the Context + Skill Fabric, Task 14, and Task 15, unchanged): Task 16A is now accepted history. GET /admin/operator is a new, additive, thin transport-adapter page over the Task 15 operator HTTP contracts; the legacy GET / and GET /admin PM dashboard are left byte-for-byte unchanged (both coexist). The client submission identity has an explicit pending/resolved lifecycle: while PENDING (no definitive server response yet), a retry -- network failure, lost/ambiguous response, or an operator resubmitting the same unresolved action -- reuses the same intentId/idempotencyKey/submittedAt. A response only resolves the identity when it is DEFINITIVE per the accepted Task 15 contract (a recognized run object, 401/403 pre-persistence rejection, a structured 409 reuse/conflict outcome, or a structured 400 validation rejection); an arbitrary 5xx or malformed/unparseable body stays UNCERTAIN and leaves the identity PENDING. Once resolved, a later deliberate identical user action mints a brand-new logical identity rather than replaying the resolved one. A 202 INTERRUPTED response is itself a definitive, known-accepted outcome; continuing that specific workflow goes through the explicit Resume workflow action (POST /v1/workflows/:workflowId/resume), never a second POST /v1/intents. Task 16B (field PM dashboard pilot) is not represented by this receipt and is not accepted history. Task 17 is not accepted. No deployment.
